bifrost: springboard/src/shell/screenshot.rs (screenshot chord), springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs (save_capture), springboard/mcp/src/wl.rs (capture_screen, ext-image-copy-capture window capture), springboard/mcp/src/tools.rs (screenshot tool)
summary: The system layer captures single frames: the Power plus Volume Up chord saves a PNG and the agent tooling reads the compositor's screen and window pixels. No app-facing SDK API exists for streams, content filters, shareable content, the content-sharing picker or recording, so apps cannot do what ScreenCaptureKit offers.

features.feature: Stream screen content to an app (SCStream, SCStreamConfiguration, SCStreamOutput)
features.apple: SCStream, SCStreamConfiguration, SCStreamOutput, SCStreamOutputType, SCStreamFrameInfo, SCFrameStatus
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 4 (w4-screencapturekit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The compositor exposes wlr-screencopy and ext-image-copy-capture, but only the agent MCP server uses them. No app receives a frame stream.

features.feature: Discover displays, apps and windows to capture (SCShareableContent, SCDisplay, SCRunningApplication, SCWindow)
features.apple: SCShareableContent, SCShareableContentInfo, SCShareableContentStyle, SCDisplay, SCRunningApplication, SCWindow
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 4 (w4-screencapturekit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The window list is available to the agent tooling only. Apps get no enumeration API.

The filter covers one window, or one display with a rule over its windows (include or exclude windows, include or exclude apps, with exceptions), and reports its menu bar flag and a scale that reads zero, negative or non-finite values as 1; all of it is tested headless. Gap: the shell's capture stream does not read the filter yet, so it is not applied to a live capture, which needs the lab machine.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 5 (w5-screencapturekit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The chord saves to Photos and the shell's tests cover it (springboard/src/shell/tests.rs, screenshot_chord_saves_a_png_shows_the_thumbnail_and_opens_photos). No app SDK call takes a capture. Output is PNG only and the configuration has no size, quality or scale options.

features.feature: Capture a single window even when covered (window image capture source)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/capture_filter.rs (ContentFilter::window, captured); springboard/mcp/src/wl.rs (one window through ext-image-copy-capture and ext-foreign-toplevel-image-capture-source)
features.note: The window filter picks a covered window by its id and is tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-os-05.rs. Gap: no app receives pixels for the filter, the pixel path is used by the agent tooling only, and the shell's chord captures the full screen.

features.feature: System content-sharing picker (SCContentSharingPicker, SCContentSharingPickerConfiguration, SCContentSharingPickerMode, SCContentSharingPickerObserver)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 5 (w5-screencapturekit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The picker is Apple's recommended selection UI. BifrOSt has no equivalent and no portal frontend for screen sharing.

features.feature: Permission for screen recording and persistent capture (Persistent Content Capture, privacy string)
features.apple: Persistent Content Capture symbol, screen recording permission prompt
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 5 (w5-screencapturekit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No permission model covers screen capture for apps.

features.feature: Clip buffering and recording editor (SCClipBufferingOutput, SCRecordingEditor, SCVideoEffectOutput)
features.apple: SCClipBufferingOutput, SCRecordingEditor, SCVideoEffectOutput and their delegates
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 19 tests. Wave 2 (theme-17, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No instant-replay buffer or recording editor exists. The media stack is audio-focused (springboard/audiod) plus hardware video decode in springboard/src/media/. round 75, host only: clip buffer and trim model.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 4 (w4-screencapturekit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. There is no stream to report errors for.

gaps: No SCStream output-delegate object: screen streams deliver frames as service events (springboard/sdk/src/screen_stream.rs).
No content enumeration API for apps (SCShareableContent and its displays, applications and windows).
No content filter (SCContentFilter) for per-window or per-app capture.
No system content-sharing picker or xdg-desktop-portal screencast frontend.
No screen-recording permission flow for apps.
Apps with the Screen permission can request a screenshot (springboard/sdk/src/screenshot.rs), but cannot request a frame with size, scale or format options (SCScreenshotConfiguration).
No clip buffering or recording editor (SCClipBufferingOutput, SCRecordingEditor).
